title: A complaint to the all-star: brakes that squeal a week after the job
demonstrates: Slot 16 in writing: the customer's name twice, 'if it were my car', two times to choose from, a summary, her name at the end. She raises the chat to High herself, books a free check under the warranty, and after it tells the customer what was wrong in plain words, including that it was the shop's doing. Two drafts edited, one written over; labelled and resolved.

customer.name: Gloria Yancey
customer.note: a regular of the Bonny Oaks shop; 2014 Toyota Highlander; front brakes done the week before

scenario.who_writes: A regular who does not like to complain.
scenario.what_happens: The brakes fitted last week squeal at every stop. Angie thanks her for saying so, offers today at 1:00 or tomorrow at 7:30, no charge. In the afternoon the customer asks what it was: an anti-rattle clip not seated on one side.

facts.warranty: 24 months or 24,000 miles on parts and labour (ledger s12.warranty)
facts.found: an anti-rattle clip not fully seated; both sides reseated, road tested

avatar.shows: sunrise over a lake with fog on the water

timeline.text: Angie I hate to complain but the brakes yall put on last week are squealing every time I stop
Good morning, Gloria. I'm sorry about the noise. New brake pads sometimes squeal while they bed in, but it should be checked. We'd like to look at it. Which day works for you?
timeline.why_a_draft: the channel is set to drafts

timeline.text:
Good morning, Gloria, and please don't apologize, I'm glad you told me. That's not how I want you leaving here. New pads can squeal until they seat, but if it were my car I'd want it looked at, not guessed at. Bring the Highlander by today at 1:00 or tomorrow at 7:30 and we'll pull the wheels while you wait. No charge, Gloria: it's under our warranty.
Angie

timeline.how: set by a manager: the base level

timeline.text: today at 1 is fine. thank you
Thank you, Gloria. Today at 1:00 works. See you then.
timeline.why_a_draft: the channel is set to drafts

timeline.text:
You're all set, Gloria: today at 1:00, here at Bonny Oaks, a brake noise check on the Highlander, no charge. I'll walk out to the car with you myself.
Angie
all quiet now 🙌 what was it
I'm glad it's quiet now, Gloria! I don't have the technician's notes in front of me; I'll find out what it was and let you know.
timeline.why_a_draft: the channel is set to drafts

timeline.text:
So glad, Gloria! The pads were fine. One of the little anti-rattle clips wasn't seated all the way, and that's on us. They reseated both sides and road tested it. Any noise at all, you message me.
Angie

reads_back.operator_credit: slot 16: first answer 5.8 minutes (her ledger row is 6), three replies, two drafts edited and one discarded, a base priority of High set by her, one resolved

truth.outcome: checked the same day at no charge; an anti-rattle clip reseated; resolved by slot 16
facts: a brake noise a week after a brake job at east
slot 16 set the priority to High and booked a free check the same day
the cause was a clip not seated at the first job; she said so

why: She does not defend the job and does not blame the pads: she books the look.
The draft that could not know the answer is the one she wrote over.
new_facts: Gloria Yancey, 2014 Toyota Highlander: front brakes at east in week T-16; a no-charge brake noise check on the Wednesday of week T-15 at 13:00 (an anti-rattle clip reseated): a warranty order pointing at the first one.
